ruling.reasoning:
This is a metered RydeTAXI trip, so extra mileage enters the metered fare and any refund is computed per segment under RD-2 at the fare record's rate, distance fare ÷ distance km = $1.4100/km [F5][F8][RD-2]. The GPS record establishes exactly two off-route segments, each reviewed separately under RD-1: F3 (17:04–17:11, +2.44 km) and F4 (17:18–17:23, +2.58 km) [F3][F4][RD-1].

Segment F4: no rider message precedes its 17:18 start — the only rider message is F10 at 17:02, which answered the driver's question about the pre-departure jam on the PIE and says nothing about a second turn-off [F10][F11][F4]. The only explanation is the driver's post-trip statement F12, and a driver's claim of agreement in his own statement is not the rider's consent (G11) [F12]. On the ground both advocates state, consent_after_or_none, this segment counts as an unexempted deviation under RD-5/RD-1 [F4][F10][F11][F12][RD-5][RD-1]. Its mileage at the record's rate is 2.58 × $1.4100 = $3.6384 → $3.64 [F4][F5][F8][RD-2].

Segment F3: the driver's pre-segment ask named a specific road, Bedok North Road, and the rider's 17:02 "Sure, your call." preceded the 17:04 start [F9][F10][F3]. Under RD-5 an agreement to a named road covers driving on that road only, and the record must tie the segment to it; nothing does — F3 carries only times and km, the chat is complete at two timestamped messages, and no fact places the car on Bedok North Road [F3][F11][RD-5]. Timing alone does not supply the tie, so the scope of the consent is undetermined under G13; the rider's words can equally be read as a general route choice, and where the kind of agreement is contested no exemption executes [F9][F10][RD-5]. That finding changes the refundable amount (2.44 km × $1.4100 = $3.4416 → $3.44 more), so the case cannot be decided automatically and goes to a person [F3][F4][RD-1][RD-2].

No RD-4 excuse operates for either segment: no traffic incident was recorded near the route in the trip window, and the only speed records are band 4 (30–39 km/h) on the PIE and CTE, which are not band 1/2 and do not exempt on their own [F13][F14][F15][RD-4]. The billed excess of 5.36 km is not the refund base; corridor and matching mileage outside any segment is excluded [F5][F8][RD-2].
